questions.question: Which of the following books is INCORRECTLY paired with its respective author?
questions.option_1: Why I am an Atheist – Bhagat Singh
questions.option_2: The Discovery of India – Subhash Chandra Bose
questions.solution:
• Incorrect Pair: The Discovery of India – Subhash Chandra Bose
  • Correction: 'The Discovery of India' was written by Jawaharlal Nehru while he was imprisoned at Ahmednagar Fort.

questions.question: Who among the following was one of the Navratnas of Akbar?
questions.solution:
• Mughal Musician: Tansen
  • Navratna: Tansen was the most celebrated musician in Akbar's court, known for his mastery of the dhrupad style.

questions.question: Valabhi, a city of ancient India was the capital of the _________ dynasty from the 5th to 8th Century CE.
questions.solution:
• Maitraka Capital: Valabhi
  • History: Valabhi was a major center of learning and the capital of the Maitraka dynasty in Gujarat.

questions.question: Which of the following organisations, divided into two branches, was established by Lokmanya Bal Gangadhar Tilak and Annie Besant?
questions.solution:
• Home Rule: Home Rule League
  • 1916: Tilak launched his league in April, followed by Annie Besant in September, to demand self-government within the British Empire.

questions.question: Which of the following battles is considered the formal beginning of the British Raj in India?
questions.solution:
• British Raj Start: Battle of Plassey
  • 1757: The defeat of Siraj-ud-Daulah by Robert Clive laid the political foundation for British rule in India.

questions.question: Who among the following was the last sultan of Delhi sultanate?
questions.solution:
• Last Sultan: Ibrahim Lodi
  • Sultanate: He was defeated by Babur in the First Battle of Panipat (1526), ending the Delhi Sultanate.

questions.question: In which of the following cities did Mahatma Gandhi lead the peasant movement against the imposed indigo cultivation by the British planters?
questions.solution:
• Indigo Movement: Champaran
  • Context: Gandhi traveled to Champaran at the request of Rajkumar Shukla to address the grievances of indigo cultivators.

questions.question: According to the Ashrama system of Vedic life, which of the following was the third stage of life?
questions.solution:
• Ashrama Stages: Vanaprastha
  • Order: The sequence is Brahmacharya (student), Grihastha (householder), Vanaprastha (forest-dweller), and Sanyasa (renunciate).

questions.question:
With reference to Morley-Minto Reforms of 1909, consider the following statements.

a) They are also called the Indian Councils Act, 1909.

b) They increased the strength of Legislative Councils.

c) The right to separate electorate was given to the Muslims.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
• 1909 Act: a, b, c
  • Fact: The Morley-Minto reforms increased the size of councils and introduced the controversial system of separate electorates.

questions.question: Which of the following events took place in the United Provinces in February, 1922?
questions.solution:
• 1922 Incident: Chauri Chaura
  • Result: Following the violence at Chauri Chaura, Gandhi immediately called off the Non-Cooperation Movement.

questions.question: Vasudeva I who issued coins in gold (dinars and quarter dinars) and copper (single denomination) was a _________king.
questions.solution:
• Kushana Ruler: Vasudeva I
  • Coinage: He was the last of the 'Great Kushanas' and his coins frequently depicted Hindu deities like Shiva.

questions.question: According to which of the following foreign travellers, people of Delhi used to write letters containing abuses to the Sultan, therefore, in order to punish them Sultan decided to shift the capital?
questions.solution:
• Traveler Account: Ibn Batuta
  • Capital Shift: He noted that Muhammad bin Tughlaq forced the population of Delhi to move to Daulatabad to punish their insolence.

questions.question: Which of the following plays was NOT written by Harshavardhana?
questions.solution:
• Harsha's Works: Vikramorvasiyam
  • Correction: Vikramorvasiyam was written by Kalidasa. Harsha wrote Ratnavali, Nagananda, and Priyadarshika.

questions.question: With reference to Sepoy Mutiny of 1857, on which of the following dates did the soldiers at Meerut start their journey to Delhi?
questions.solution:
• 1857 Start: 10 May
  • Mutiny: The revolt at Meerut began on May 10, and the sepoys reached Delhi the following day to declare the Mughal King as their leader.

questions.question: The magnificent Kailasa temple at Ellora was built during the reign of which Rashtrakuta king?
questions.solution:
• Kailasa Temple: Krishna I
  • Art: This monolithic structure at Ellora was carved out of a single rock during the 8th century.

questions.question: The Vedangas are Hindu auxiliary disciplines that originated in ancient times and are linked to the study of the Vedas. These are _________ in number.
questions.solution:
• Vedic Study: six
  • Vedangas: The six branches are Shiksha, Kalpa, Vyakarana, Nirukta, Chhanda, and Jyotisha.

questions.question: Who established Shantiniketan and when?
questions.solution:
• Tagore's School: Ravindranath Tagore, 1901
  • Fact: Shantiniketan was founded on the philosophy of nature-based education and later became Visva-Bharati University.

questions.question: Who among the following freedom fighters is known as ‘Deshbandhu’?
questions.solution:
• Title: Chittaranjan Das
  • Deshbandhu: Meaning 'Friend of the Nation,' C.R. Das was a prominent lawyer and the co-founder of the Swaraj Party.

questions.question: Chand Bardai’s famous literary work ________, mentions Prithviraj Chauhan‘s love story and heroic deeds.
questions.solution:
• Chauhan Epic: Prithviraj Raso
  • Author: Chand Bardai, the court poet of Prithviraj Chauhan, wrote this epic in the Brajbhasha dialect.

questions.question: Who among the following is primarily connected to the World’s Parliament of Religions convened in Chicago, 1893?
questions.solution:
• Parliament of Religions: Swami Vivekananda
  • 1893: His speech at Chicago introduced the wisdom of Hindu philosophy and Yoga to the Western world.

questions.question: In which of the following battles did Muhammad of Ghor defeat Jayachandra of Gahadavala dynasty in 1194 AD?
questions.solution:
• Battle of Chandawar: 1194 AD
  • History: Muhammad Ghori defeated Jayachandra of Kannauj in this battle, further solidifying Muslim rule in North India.

questions.question: Who was the Viceroy of India when Mahatma Gandhi started Dandi March on 12 March 1930?
questions.solution:
• 1930 Viceroy: Lord Irwin
  • Salt March: Lord Irwin was the Viceroy who later negotiated the Gandhi-Irwin Pact to end the civil disobedience.

questions.question: The _________ were tributary chiefs of the Gupta dynasty. They established an independent kingdom in western India. Dhruvasena II was the most important ruler of this kingdom.
questions.solution:
• Maitraka Dynasty: Maitrakas
  • Origin: The Maitrakas were military governors under the Guptas who later established their own independent kingdom in Valabhi.

questions.question: In which of the following areas did the Uprising of Khurda in 1817 take place?
questions.solution:
• Odisha Uprising: Odisha
  • Khurda: The Paika Rebellion of 1817 in Khurda was an armed uprising against British land and tax policies.
